metadata.source: See sources below; rates checked 7 Nov 2026 (audit findings 31-33 applied)
metadata.rate_year: Forestry Grant Scheme rates as listed on ruralpayments.org when checked 7 Nov 2026: WIG Restructuring Regeneration (published 1 Oct 2024); WIG Habitats and Species (page dated 5 Jul 2019); FGS Deer Fence capital item (page dated 22 Jul 2015)

sources.restocking_grant_per_ha: WIG Restructuring Regeneration (ruralpayments.org, published 1 Oct 2024): £300/ha 'Delivering UK Forestry Standard Woodland' (≤65% single species, ≥10% other species) or £550/ha 'Delivering Diversity and Resilience Woodland' (≤60% single species, ≥20% other species); rate set by the approved forest plan or Felling Permission area; minimum stocking 2,500 conifer or 1,600 broadleaf/native Scots pine stems/ha. PAWS conversion to native woodland earns 3 scoring points, not a payment uplift. Default £550 applies only if the diversity tier is met; £300 otherwise.
sources.restocking_tiers_per_ha: 300 or 550 (see above); +£60/ha vegetative propagation supplement (improved Sitka, YC≥14) not relevant to PAWS conversion.
sources.deer_fencing_grant_per_m: FGS Deer Fence capital item: eligible only under Woodland Creation or WIG Habitats and Species, where the Scottish Government agrees deer damage would otherwise prevent the objectives (ruralpayments.org Deer Fence page, dated 22 Jul 2015). Rate £9.50/m from the WIG Habitats and Species page (dated 5 Jul 2019). Not listed as claimable with Restructuring Regeneration. Previously £9.90/m (a Woodland Creation rate).
sources.tree_protection_per_tree: Set to £0. No tree-protection item is listed for Restructuring Regeneration. The £2.00 tree shelter is a Woodland Creation capital item. WIG Habitats and Species lists 'Protecting Natural Regeneration' at £2.90 per tree (natural regeneration, not planted trees). Confirm any protection route with Scottish Forestry.
sources.rhododendron_clearance_per_ha: Set to £0 by default. WIG Habitats and Species rates are per hectare of INFESTED land and by method (page dated 5 Jul 2019): manual light/medium/difficult £3,500/£5,500/£7,300; mechanised £2,200/£3,400/£5,600; foliar spray £200; stem injection medium/difficult £3,000/£4,500; follow-up £200. The previous £1,500/ha was the 'Scrub/woody vegetation – intermediate' rate applied to the whole site.
sources.natural_regen_grant_per_ha: Set to £0. The previous 0.7 × restocking-rate formula had no source. WIG Habitats and Species lists 'New Natural Regeneration Establishment' £300/ha and 'Protecting Natural Regeneration' £2.90 per tree; eligibility for a PAWS site must be confirmed.
sources.timber: Units are cubic metres overbark (m³ ob) standing. Reference price: GB coniferous standing sales average £35.17/m³ overbark, year to March 2026 (Forest Research, Timber Price Indices, published 28 May 2026, as cited by the 3 Nov 2026 independent audit; PDF not opened here). The index is a GB all-conifer average: species-specific prices are not published, so all species default to it. Standing sales prices are paid by the buyer, who bears harvesting; the difficulty penalty (£/m³) is an assumption for local access and extraction. Yield 350 m³ ob/ha is a placeholder: replace with a site inventory.
sources.esg_and_long_term_values: Optional scenarios with no contract or named payer; excluded from the base case (ESG default £0). The natural-capital audit 'income' has been removed (an audit is a cost, not income, unless someone pays for it). England's statutory Biodiversity Net Gain does not apply in Scotland.

metadata.grant_status: Grant income is CONDITIONAL and excluded from the default business case. It is included only when the user ticks "Include conditional grants", and even then depends on an approved Felling Permission or forest/management plan, the species-composition tier being met, and Scottish Forestry approval of each item.

timber.note: Placeholder standing volume for a mature conifer crop; replace with a site inventory (m³ overbark/ha).

sitka_spruce.label: Sitka Spruce
sitka_spruce.note: GB all-conifer standing-sales average applied; species premium/discount not published

scots_pine.label: Scots Pine
scots_pine.note: GB all-conifer standing-sales average applied; species premium/discount not published

larch.label: Larch
larch.note: GB all-conifer average applied; Phytophthora ramorum statutory notices may affect sale and value

timber.difficulty_penalty_note: £ per m³ ob deducted for access/extraction difficulty; assumption, not sourced

fgs_grants.note: Conditional FGS grants (see metadata.sources and metadata.grant_status). Excluded from the default business case.
fgs_grants.note_regen: No grant assumed for the natural-regeneration area unless eligibility is confirmed (WIG Habitats and Species 'New Natural Regeneration Establishment' £300/ha may apply).

costs.note_fencing: Real-world contractor rate; FGS grant covers ~79% of this (£9.50/£12)
costs.note_tree: Bare-root native broadleaf whips, including stakes and guards
costs.note_diy_fencing: Materials only — assumes landowner provides labour
costs.note_diy_planting: Materials only — bare-root whips, no contractor planting labour

esg.note: Optional scenario only: private nature-finance sponsorship needs a named sponsor and agreement. Default £0. WCC carbon credits NOT applicable to PAWS restocking. England's statutory BNG does not apply in Scotland.

long_term_values.note: OPTIONAL SCENARIOS, not part of the business case: no contracts or payers are in place. Firewood/biomass, sporting and voluntary biodiversity-credit values are indicative assumptions.
long_term_values.note_bng: Annualised voluntary biodiversity credit value assuming a 30-year agreement; indicative assumption (statutory BNG is England-only).
long_term_values.note_natural_capital: Removed (was £280/ha/yr): an audit is a cost, not income, unless a payer is identified.

legacy_aliases_note: timber.yield_tons_per_ha, species.*.price_per_ton and fgs_grants.natural_regen_discount are kept ONLY so a cached pre-2.1 app (one session after deploy, before the new service worker takes over) does not produce NaN. Values equal the m³ ob figures; the 0.7 factor is set to 0. Current code ignores them.
